12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: I was seated on the Sila Orica in the Grand Hall. My court had gathered for the 'Hearing of Petitions'.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: This ceremony was a remnant from olden times, even going back to the days of the first Toras, Henricus.

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: Five goblets were placed on a table, each decorated with a different ornament according to the seat it represented. A petitioner would drop a small object of personal importance in the goblet.

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: I personally found it extremely old-fashioned and banal. I walked to the center of the Throne Room.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: Whether or not I cared for it didn't matter. The rules were the rules. I walked to the center of the Throne Room.

21.speaker: Narrator

137.speaker: Sal Ignacius
137.text: "My King. I petition myself for the position of Grand Vizier in servitude to the crown."

138.speaker: Angelica Sazon
138.text: "My King. I petition myself for the position of Grand Vizier in servitude to the crown."

141.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
141.text: "My Liege. I petition myself for the position of War and Security Councillor in servitude to the crown."

142.speaker: Titus Gordion
142.text: "My King. I petition myself for the position of War and Security Councillor in servitude to the crown."

143.speaker: Daria de Rava
143.text: "My King. I petition myself for the position of Treasury and Economy Councillor in servitude to the crown."

144.speaker: Russello Montoro
144.text: "My King. I petition myself for the position of Treasury and Economy Councillor in servitude to the crown."

145.speaker: Vina Toras
145.text: "My King. I petition myself for the position of Foreign Affairs Councillor in servitude to the crown."

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: As soon as I came to a decision, I was to melt the mementos from the goblet into the molten gold until they dissolved.

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "I reject all of your petitions. The seat of Grand Vizier will remain empty."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "I choose Axel Reinhart to be my Grand Vizier."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "I choose Angelica Sazon to be my Grand Vizier."

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "I choose Sal Ignacius to be my Grand Vizier."

178.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
178.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CouncilPetition_Security_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CouncilPetition_Security_Taddeus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CouncilPetition_Security_Titus"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Petition_Security_Rico"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Petition_Security_Taddeus"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Petition_Security_Titus"] == true)

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "I reject the petitions. Lucita Azaro will remain my War and Security Councillor."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "I choose Taddeus Azaro to be my War and Security Councillor."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "I choose Rico Toras to be my War and Security Councillor."

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "I choose Titus Gordion to be my War and Security Councillor."

233.text: I took my place in the circle as part of the ceremony. I was the only one standing at the center.

234.speaker: Narrator
234.text: I took my place in the circle as part of the ceremony.

235.speaker: Narrator
235.text: I turned to my court for the ending words.

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "I proclaim the end of the Hearing of Petitions."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "When it comes time for the next council reshuffle, do not trouble me with such weak petitions."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "It was promising but unfortunately it only stayed that way."

239.speaker: Narrator
239.text: The nobles left the Throne Room in silence, perhaps a bit disappointed by the lack of a show.

240.speaker: Narrator
240.text: Suddenly I was the only one left in the huge room.

242.speaker: Narrator
242.text: Golden knives were handed to all of us.

243.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
243.text: Cut your hand and spill the blood into the molten gold.

244.speaker: Narrator
244.text: My newest council member followed suit.

248.speaker: Narrator
248.text: The others followed suit and mixed in their blood.

249.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
249.text: Pull the lever to cast the molten gold into necklaces.

250.speaker: Narrator
250.text: An odd smell filled the room as the gold, mementos and blood mingled.

251.speaker: Narrator
251.text: As I watched the gold slowly sizzle and cool down, I contemplated what I had done.

252.speaker: Narrator
252.text: The pain in my hand pulled me from my thoughts. A medic rushed over to tend to the cut.

254.speaker: Sal Ignacius
254.text: "We have so much we can do together. I can help you, as I helped your father."

255.speaker: Sal Ignacius
255.text: "As your Grand Vizier, I will do whatever I can to guide you through the darkness with the light of God."

256.speaker: Sal Ignacius
256.text: "There are many in Rizia that would rejoice to see a man of faith ascend to such an important post."

257.speaker: Sal Ignacius
257.text: "Such believers can be... utilized to aid the goals of the crown. I pray you will make the right choice."

258.speaker: Angelica Sazon
258.text: "Before my exile, I was one of the most educated noblewomen in Brenas. On Caleqabiz, I spent much of my time reading about the principles of governance."

259.speaker: Angelica Sazon
259.text: "Appoint me as Vizier and you can expect both complete honesty and undying loyalty. Remember, I turned my own husband over to your father."

260.speaker: Angelica Sazon
260.text: "That is what I can offer to you and to the crown. Nothing more, nothing less."

261.speaker: Axel Reinhart
261.text: "I ask you: What better action to signify the friendship between Rizians and Palesians?"

262.speaker: Axel Reinhart
262.text: "This is the logical choice, and I think you know it."

263.speaker: Axel Reinhart
263.text: "If you make me your Grand Vizier, I assure you that it will guarantee the trust of Palesians and along with it, the international community..."

264.speaker: Axel Reinhart
264.text: "I am also a capable politician and a ruthless negotiator, as you have experienced firsthand. I can provide you with contacts that nobody else can."

265.speaker: Axel Reinhart
265.text: "What better move to stir the hearts of your people? Romus, the Great Unifier! Your name will be written down in history."

266.speaker: Axel Reinhart
266.text: "That is my pitch, if you will, Your Majesty."
266.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CouncilPetition_ForeignAffairs_Vina"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Successor_Son"] == true) == false)

267.speaker: Rico Toras
267.text: "You know very well what I am capable of, cousin."

268.speaker: Rico Toras
268.text: "I know how to wage war. I know how to maintain security. It sounds like I fill both of the roles required from this post."

269.speaker: Rico Toras
269.text: "You already know the great work I've done as Chief of Police here in Porte Drazon. No need to delve further into that."

270.speaker: Rico Toras
270.text: "But that is not my only merit, as you know. Hire me, and the Crown will have Rizia's largest and most passionate civilian security force at its fingertips."

271.speaker: Rico Toras
271.text: "My father may be good, but I assure you, I am better."

272.speaker: Rico Toras
272.text: "As a Toras, I also think it is good to keep things in the family."

273.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
273.text: "All my life I have fought for this country. I bled for it. I went through hell for it."

274.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
274.text: "I know the ins and outs of our country's military structure. More importantly, I command the respect of the Rizian Armed Forces and House Azaro."

275.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
275.text: "I know every single one of our General Staff because I trained them. I fought alongside them."

276.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
276.text: "War will come to Rizia someday, sire. And to protect the interests of my proud kingdom, I am ready to die a thousand deaths."

277.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
277.text: "My daughter is ready to step aside. She has another role to play now."
277.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

278.speaker: Titus Gordion
278.text: "I protected you and your father for many years as part of the Golden Guard, and hopefully I will do so for many more."

279.speaker: Titus Gordion
279.text: "My entire life, I always felt that in order to do my job better, I needed more and more of a say in matters."

280.speaker: Titus Gordion
280.text: "I want to be elevated to a position that will allow me to have that say."

281.speaker: Titus Gordion
281.text: "Trust in me and the Golden Guard, and security will never be a worry in Rizia again."
281.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Won"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Sal_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false)

283.speaker: Daria de Rava
283.text: "If I cannot serve you in the House of Delegates, then the Royal Council will have to do."

285.speaker: Daria de Rava
285.text: "I and my family still have considerable influence in international investment circles, and I have accumulated numerous contacts that might be of use to us."

286.speaker: Daria de Rava
286.text: "Treasurer of Rizia is a position that requires more than mere number-crunching. One needs considerable political finesse."

287.speaker: Russello Montoro
287.text: "That's right. I want this job so much I'm willing to go through *all* the formalities. I even bought a new tie."

288.speaker: Russello Montoro
288.text: "We got almost half of RRG back into the Royal Family's well-manicured hands."

289.speaker: Russello Montoro
289.text: "Just look at how much gold we're hauling out of the ground right now. All thanks to me."
289.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_RRG_StateOwns45"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_RRG_StateOwns15"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_LocalGoldExtraction_High"] == true)

290.speaker: Russello Montoro
290.text: "All apologies to the old gal Werner, but you'd be doing her a favor by sending her off to an early retirement. The Treasury needs some fresh blood."
290.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_RRG_StateOwns45"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_RRG_StateOwns15"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_LocalGoldExtraction_High"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AssassinationOrdered"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_RustyPMC"] == true) == false)

291.speaker: Russello Montoro
291.text: "Not to make a big deal about it, Your Majesty, but you did promise me this a while back. I hope those weren't just empty words."

292.speaker: Vina Toras
292.text: "Father. I know you still see me as your little girl. Maybe you don't think that I'm ready."

293.speaker: Vina Toras
293.text: "But I have been on your council for some time now. I understand its intricacies very well."

294.speaker: Vina Toras
294.text: "Laurento has been like a grandfather to me, but he's past his prime and you know it. It's time for the younger generation to represent Rizia on the global stage."

295.speaker: Vina Toras
295.text: "As for me... well, you know better than anybody that work is all I have."

296.speaker: Vina Toras
296.text: "We have had our differences. But please. Grant me this."

298.speaker: Narrator
298.text: I looked at the bright red, sizzling molten gold until my eyes began to water.

306.speaker: Angelica Sazon
306.text: "I do not only ask this of you as the mother of the Prince Consort."

307.speaker: Angelica Sazon
307.text: "By reinstating me as Duchess of Brenas, you showed deep faith in my capabilities and in my noble house."

308.speaker: Angelica Sazon
308.text: "By bringing me back from exile, you showed that House Toras was ready to place its faith in House Sazon once more."

309.speaker: Angelica Sazon
309.text: "I can think of no better way to return that gesture of faith than to serve on your council."

313.speaker: Angelica Sazon
313.text: "You already trusted my judgement once, when you cancelled the ill-advised reforms you were planning."

317.speaker: Angelica Sazon
317.text: "I know you hunger for change. I can help you achieve your goals while keeping the nobility satisfied."

318.speaker: Angelica Sazon
318.text: "And I am still prepared to keep the more... unruly elements of my house in line."

322.speaker: Axel Reinhart
322.text: "I realize that it's rather unorthodox to serve as the principal advisor to one's father-in-law. Rest assured that my own interests will come second to those of the Toras royal family. Every time."

323.speaker: Axel Reinhart
323.text: "I realize that it's rather unorthodox to serve as the principal advisor to a man nearly twice my age. Rest assured that my own interests will come second to yours. Every time."

327.speaker: Player_Romus
327.text: "I reject all of your petitions. Hugo Toras will remain my Grand Vizier."

331.speaker: Rico Toras
331.text: "Respectfully, after deposing me and shooting my dog... this is the least you can do."

332.speaker: Rico Toras
332.text: "Respectfully, after deposing me as Duke of Iza... this is the least you can do."

334.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
334.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

335.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
335.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

336.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
336.text: "Not that I even need to do so, in my opinion. Despite my temporary leave of absence and current physical disability, I am more than capable of resuming my previous role."

340.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
340.text: "An Azaro belongs in this role. You know it. I know it."
340.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false)

341.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
341.text: "My daughter will be disappointed. But she will fill the role once more when she is ready."
341.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false)

342.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
342.text: "I trust you to make the right decision."

346.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
346.text: "Do not forget that it was only with my help that the second and final Pales War was won."

350.speaker: Titus Gordion
350.text: "Just as Duchess Azaro failed you, so will her father. I guarantee you that."

354.speaker: Titus Gordion
354.text: "You trusted House Azaro, and they guided you into an unwinnable war. I swear that would never have happened under my watch."
354.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Won"] == false)

358.speaker: Titus Gordion
358.text: "Do not forget how my skills served you in getting to the bottom of the Zille incident."
358.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Won"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false)

360.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
360.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Sal_Arrested"] == true

361.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
361.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Sal_Arrested"] == true) == false

362.speaker: Titus Gordion
362.text: "I also ask you to remember certain other tasks I have performed for you. Loyally and without question."
362.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Won"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Sal_Arrested"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false)

366.speaker: Titus Gordion
366.text: "Think about how much the Golden Guard has helped you accomplish thus far."
366.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Won"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true)

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "I reject the petitions. Titus Gordion will remain my War and Security Councillor."
373.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Security_Titus"] == true)

374.speaker: Player_Romus
374.text: "I reject the petitions. Taddeus Azaro will remain my War and Security Councillor."
374.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  or   Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Security_Titus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Security_Taddeus"] == true)

378.speaker: Player_Romus
378.text: "I reject the petitions. The role of War and Security Councillor will remain empty."

382.speaker: Daria de Rava
382.text: "Appoint me, and I promise I will restore Rizia's budget surplus back to its former glory."
382.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] < 5) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Final_Nationalized_NoShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Final_Renegotiated_NoShare"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Energy_Modifier_AureusGasField"] == 0) == false)

383.speaker: Daria de Rava
383.text: "The same skills you saw me display as House Speaker, I would bring to bear as your councilor."

387.speaker: Daria de Rava
387.text: "Coming out of the MITZ with nothing? I never would have allowed that to happen."

391.speaker: Daria de Rava
391.text: "Coming away from the Aureus dispute with nothing? I never would have allowed that to happen."

392.speaker: Daria de Rava
392.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] < 5) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Final_Nationalized_NoShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Final_Renegotiated_NoShare"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Energy_Modifier_AureusGasField"] == 0) == false)

399.speaker: Russello Montoro
399.text: "You gave me and my company more control over Rizia's gold industry than at any point in history. That's got to mean something."

407.speaker: Vina Toras
407.text: "You trusted me enough to send me to Pales."

411.speaker: Vina Toras
411.text: "As for me... children are still a ways in the future. And Manus and I won't be raising them without help, anyway."

415.speaker: Vina Toras
415.text: "You already know how well you and I work together. Please, grant me this."

416.speaker: Vina Toras
416.text: "Finally, I will remind you that I'm no longer your successor. Unless something happens to {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}, I'll never be Queen."

420.speaker: Vina Toras
420.text: "If I cannot follow in the footsteps of Lyza the Great, at least grant me this."

424.speaker: Angelica Sazon
424.text: "And I am still prepared to keep the more... unruly elements of my house in line. Including those who are upset that the Sazons no longer control Zille."

428.speaker: Axel Reinhart
428.text: "As I'm no longer in line to become King Consort... I hope you will consider granting me this as a consolation prize."

432.speaker: Sal Ignacius
432.text: "Remember our conversation in Benievon, Your Majesty. Place your trust in me, and the blessings will be infinite."

440.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
440.text: "Pales is not our only enemy. More war will come to this kingdom. And to protect my Rizia, I am ready to die a thousand times over."

461.speaker: Russello Montoro
461.text: "Look. We've been through a lot, you and I."

466.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
466.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AssassinationOrdered"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_RustyPMC"] == true

467.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
467.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AssassinationOrdered"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_RustyPMC"] == true) == false

468.speaker: Russello Montoro
468.text: "Look. I know I might not be the most natural choice for the Royal Council. But think about it for a minute."

469.speaker: Russello Montoro
469.text: "I shouldn't even have to mention the various and sundry favors I've done for you..."
469.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_RRG_StateOwns45"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_RRG_StateOwns15"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_LocalGoldExtraction_High"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RPP"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HODElection_RustyInfluence_RNC"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AssassinationOrdered"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Discovered_LespianInvolvement_Rusty"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_Deploy_RustyPMC"] == true)

473.speaker: Narrator
473.text: She looked up at me. Her eyes were moist.

477.speaker: Rico Toras
477.text: "But that is not my only merit. Hire me, and the Crown will finally be able to make use of Rizia's largest and most passionate civilian security force."

481.speaker: Axel Reinhart
481.text: "Also, naming me to your council means I'll get to work with... well, you'll see."
481.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.CouncilPetition_ForeignAffairs_Vina"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Petition_Foreign_Vina"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Successor_Son"] == true) == false)

488.speaker: Axel Reinhart
488.text: "Also, naming me to your council means I'll get to work with my wife! Ruling Rizia will truly be a family affair."
488.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.CouncilPetition_ForeignAffairs_Vina"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Petition_Foreign_Vina"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Foreign_Vina"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Successor_Son"] == true) == false)

489.speaker: Axel Reinhart
489.text: "You rejected my wife's petition... you owe it to us both to at least consider mine."
489.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.CouncilPetition_ForeignAffairs_Vina"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Petition_Foreign_Vina"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Council_Foreign_Vina"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Successor_Son"] == true) == false)

497.speaker: Rico Toras
497.text: "I know about the Queen Consort's big plans for Rizia. Are you really going to let House Azaro have that much power over the Kingdom's fate?"

498.speaker: Rico Toras
498.text: "You need a Toras to keep them in check. I'm your man."

502.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
502.text: "I have spoken with Lucita about the great changes that are coming. You're going to need my involvement to make Ana Azaro's vision a reality."
